name: completion-evidence-compatibility
goal: Require current completion evidence while preserving paired regression guards and actual module memory observations

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Module lifecycle observations must retain real timing and correctly normalized process RSS without changing operation results.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing source-profile lifecycle tests lacked the native Bun memory-unit boundary. The committed standard matrix adds it before repair.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Accepted immutable failing checkpoint 231dcf53e66483eff346fe5a7fd575dff7bee899; tests were committed before product repair.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Repair and guard native module lifecycle and memory observations. The later user choice removes automatic agent and Desktop gating.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Accepted unchanged-test passing checkpoint b357e4b82660c370fb54c6f9dd809d6782c76493 with its retained paired red record.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Frozen lifecycle proof passes at the paired fix. Later focused source-runner tests also pass; global repository checks are tracked separately.
